title: Asia markets advance on peace deal hopes, corporate earnings
title_zh: 亚洲市场因和平协议希望和企业盈利而上涨
summary: By Gregor Stuart Hunter SINGAPORE, April 16 (Reuters) - Stocks pushed higher in early Asia trading on Thursday as optimism grew about a deal to end the Iran war with the U.S. ratcheting up pressure on
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 4 月 16 日 - 周四亚洲早盘股市走高，因美国加大压力，结束伊朗战争的协议愈加乐观。

title: TSMC set to post 50% quarterly profit jump, extend record earnings on insatiable AI demand
title_zh: 台积电季度利润将增长 50%，因人工智能需求不断增长，盈利创纪录
summary: TSMC, the world's largest manufacturer of advanced artificial intelligence chips, will likely notch up a fourth ‌consecutive quarter of record earnings with a 50% surge in net profit for ‌January-March driven by booming demand for AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 全球最大的先进人工智能芯片制造商台积电可能会连续第四个季度创下盈利纪录，在人工智能基础设施需求旺盛的推动下，1 月至 3 月净利润将飙升 50%。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise after record closes, Q1 earnings roll in
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在创纪录收盘后上涨，第一季度收益公布
summary: Markets are holding steady after a record-setting day as banks and tech companies continue to see growth despite the impacts of the Iran war.
summary_zh: 尽管受到伊朗战争的影响，银行和科技公司仍继续实现增长，在创纪录的一天后，市场保持稳定。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq notch record closes on optimism around US-Iran talks
title_zh: 标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数因美伊谈判的乐观情绪而收盘
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended mostly higher on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市周三收盘大多走高。

title: D-Wave CEO says quantum computing is already past its ChatGPT moment
title_zh: D-Wave 首席执行官表示量子计算已经过了 ChatGPT 时刻
summary: Shares of the quantum firm have surged 200% over the last year as Wall Street begins to price in a pivot toward real-world commercial utility.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街开始考虑转向现实世界的商业公用事业，这家量子公司的股价去年飙升了 200%。

title: Allbirds rebrands as an AI company, Snap to cut 1,000 jobs
title_zh: Allbirds 更名为人工智能公司，Snap 裁员 1000 人
summary: Yahoo Finance Anchor Josh Lipton tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including shoemaker Allbirds (BIRD) rebranding itself as an AI company and Snap (SNAP) announcing plans to layoff 1,000 employees.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经主播乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 在本期《市场分钟》中追踪当今走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事，包括鞋履制造商 Allbirds (BIRD) 将自己重新定位为人工智能公司，以及 Snap (SNAP) 宣布计划裁员 1,000 名员工。

title: Allbirds stock soars nearly 600% as the shoemaker rebrands as an AI company
title_zh: 鞋匠将品牌重塑为人工智能公司 Allbirds 股价飙升近 600%
summary: Allbirds is getting out of the sustainable sneaker business and into the AI business.
summary_zh: Allbirds 正在退出可持续运动鞋业务，进入人工智能业务。

title: BofA CEO calls economy 'resilient,' ASML stock falls post-earnings
title_zh: 美国银行首席执行官称经济“有弹性”，ASML 股价在财报公布后下跌
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Producer John Hyland tracks Wednesday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories. Bank of America (BAC) reported quarterly earnings results.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级制作人约翰·海兰德追踪周三走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事。美国银行（BAC）公布了季度盈利结果。

title: AI trade could be overdue for a rebound amid major stock rally
title_zh: 在股市大涨之际，人工智能交易可能早就该反弹了
summary: The major market indexes (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) remain in striking distance to new record highs after recent rallies have erased the losses seen since the start of the US-Iran war.
summary_zh: 主要市场指数（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在最近的反弹抹去了自美伊战争开始以来的损失后，仍然距离新纪录高点不远。
